items.title: EIP-8141 PR #12644：MAX_VERIFY_GAS 从 10 万提到 30 万
items.note: PR 说明列出的理由：groth16 隐私池的验证前缀需要 23.3 万到 23.58 万 gas；EVM 写的哈希签名验证器在 VERIFY 中需要 10.1 万到 22.3 万 gas；按 Nethermind 基准，每个 peer 每秒约 100 笔失败交易、上限 30 万时，构建区块的最坏额外耗时为 24 到 25 ms，正好用完 25 ms 预算。
items.title_en: EIP-8141 PR #12644: raise MAX_VERIFY_GAS from 100k to 300k
items.note_en: . The PR's rationale: a groth16 privacy pool needs 233,000 to 235,800 gas for its validation prefix, and hash-based signature verifiers written in EVM code need 101k to 223k in a VERIFY frame. Per the Nethermind benchmark, about 100 failing transactions per second per peer at a 300k cap adds a worst case of 24 to 25 ms to block building, exactly the 25 ms budget.

items.title: AnkushinDaniil 的回复
items.note: 2026-11-18 04:24 给出 Nethermind 实测：构建者原来执行 IL 里的每个条目（包括 VERIFY），在 EIP-7805 字节上限下（16 个 IL × 8 KiB，每 slot 2,624 笔最小 frame 交易），上限从 10 万提到 30 万时，每 slot 耗时从 223 ms 升到 670 ms（简单循环），或从 3.2 s 升到 9.7 s（对 4 KiB 做 KECCAK256）。按 EIP-8369 只执行填充规则允许的条目后，最坏为每 slot 0.20 到 0.29 秒，且不再随上限增长；但他担心尾部截断会让已进 IL 的交易仍得不到保护。
items.note_en: At 04:24 on 2026-11-18 brought Nethermind measurements. The builder used to execute every IL entry, VERIFY included. Under EIP-7805's byte limits (16 ILs × 8 KiB, 2,624 minimal frame transactions per slot), going from a 100k to a 300k cap took per-slot time from 223 ms to 670 ms with a cheap loop, or from 3.2 s to 9.7 s with KECCAK256 over 4 KiB. Running only the entries EIP-8369's fill rule admits brings the worst case to 0.20 to 0.29 s per slot, and it no longer grows with the cap. He's still worried that tail truncation can leave a transaction unprotected even though it's in an IL.

items.title: EIP-8483 后量子材料登记（PR #12609）
items.note: 2026-11-17 17:32 收到评审：该 EIP 让验证者的提款地址登记 32 字节 PQ 材料，存进信标状态，供以后迁移分叉使用。评审者指出提款地址的所有者往往不是运营者（合约、托管方、委托质押），建议增加由 BLS 密钥触发登记的路径，否则合约要升级、托管方要支持新交易、委托人要与运营者协调，会拖慢迁移。
items.note_en: Got a review at 17:32 on 2026-11-17. The EIP lets a validator's withdrawal address register 32 bytes of PQ material, stored in the beacon state for a future migration fork. The reviewer pointed out that whoever owns the withdrawal address often isn't the operator (contracts, custodians, delegated staking) and suggested adding a path triggered by the BLS key. Otherwise contracts need upgrades, custodians need to support a new transaction, and delegators need to coordinate with operators, all of which would slow the migration.

items.note: 2026-11-17 16:56：VOPS 节点丢弃大部分执行层状态后，在现有状态树下无法给其他节点提供同步证明；需要新树（EIP-8297）让这类节点也能为自己持有的状态出证明。对节点运营者的含义是低配节点将来可行，但“谁保存全部状态”仍未解决。
items.title_en: Toni on light clients and state exchange
items.note_en: At 16:56 on 2026-11-17: once VOPS nodes drop most execution-layer state, today's state tree means they can't serve sync proofs to peers. A new tree (EIP-8297) would let them prove the state they do hold. For node operators, low-spec nodes look viable down the road, but the question of who keeps the full state is still open.

items.title_en: Vitalik urges opposition to Canada's C-22 bill
items.note_en: At 17:43 on 2026-11-17, linking Mozilla's analysis. summary_en: Frame Transaction Breakout #8 was mostly about staying forward compatible with EIP-8288. Iván said on the call he'd open a draft, and afterwards ilitteri submitted an EIP for leanSPHINCS dependency frames, where signatures travel beside the transaction and can later be swapped for an aggregate proof. The call agreed to lock down EIP-8151 and EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM) first. soispoke published a long post arguing against dropping FOCIL and other features from Hegotá in the name of pqai, and worked out that an unchanged FOCIL could force at most 16 leanSPHINCS transactions into a block. ACDE #249 meets tomorrow at 21:00 to cover Glamsterdam and Hegotá.
